name: Watercolour paint
definition: transparent water-soluble paint in tubes or pans made for painting pictures.

name: Acrylic paint
definition: water-based paint with an acrylic polymer binder made for painting pictures.

name: Oil paint
definition: artists' paint with pigment bound in drying oil.

name: Gouache
definition: opaque water-based paint made for painting pictures.

name: Art ink
definition: liquid ink made for drawing and painting pictures.

name: Printing ink
definition: ink made for relief and other hand printmaking.

name: Paint medium (acrylic medium, gesso, primer)
definition: medium, ground or primer mixed with or laid under artists' paint.

name: Coloured pencil
definition: pencil with a coloured core made for drawing.

name: Pastel
definition: stick of pigment and binder (soft, oil or hard pastel) made for drawing and painting.

name: Drawing pen and marker
definition: pen, fineliner or marker whose maker's first-named use is drawing, comics or painting (K-170).

name: Stretched canvas
definition: artists' canvas stretched on a frame, ready to paint.

name: Watercolour paper pad
definition: pad or block of paper made for watercolour painting.

name: Sketchbook
definition: bound book of blank drawing paper made for sketching.

name: Artist brush
definition: brush made for painting pictures; hair and shape are attributes (brush choice level provisional, C-16).

name: Easel
definition: stand that holds a canvas or board while it is painted (K-172).

name: Relief-cutting tool (lino and wood)
definition: hand cutter made for carving lino or wood blocks for printing.

name: Brayer
definition: hand roller made for rolling ink onto a printing block.

name: Printing press
definition: hand press made for pulling relief or intaglio prints.

name: Paint-by-numbers kit
definition: kit of a numbered printed outline with matching numbered paints and brush, sold and compared as one object (K-1).

name: Diamond-painting kit
definition: kit of a coded adhesive canvas with resin drills and applicator, sold and compared as one object (K-1).

name: Sewing machine (lockstitch)
definition: machine that sews seams with a lockstitch.

name: Overlock machine (serger)
definition: machine that trims, seams and overcasts an edge in one pass with looper threads.

name: Embroidery machine
definition: machine that stitches embroidery designs automatically from a hoop.

name: Longarm quilting machine
definition: long-throat machine on a frame made for quilting through layered fabric.

name: Plain-weave cotton (alias quilting cotton)
definition: plain-woven cotton cloth sold by the metre or as cuts for sewing and quilting.

name: Denim
definition: twill-woven cotton cloth sold for sewing.

name: Jersey
definition: knitted stretch cloth sold for sewing.

name: Felt
definition: non-woven matted cloth sold as craft or sewing material.

name: Interfacing
definition: stiffening fabric, fusible or sew-in, made to back other cloth.

name: Textile dye
definition: dye made for colouring fabric and fibre (B6-O1).

name: Fabric paint
definition: paint made to decorate fabric.

name: Sewing thread
definition: thread made for hand or machine sewing.

name: Zip
definition: zip fastener sold loose for sewing in.

name: Button
definition: button sold loose for sewing on.

name: Ribbon
definition: narrow woven strip sold for trimming and sewing.

name: Dress form (dressmaking mannequin)
definition: adjustable or fixed body form for fitting garments.

name: Dressmaking shears
definition: long-bladed shears made for cutting fabric (K-171).

name: Knitting and crochet yarn
definition: spun yarn sold in balls, skeins or cones for knitting and crochet.

name: Crochet thread
definition: fine tightly spun thread made for crochet and lacework.

name: Embroidery floss
definition: divisible stranded thread made for hand embroidery and cross stitch.

name: Unspun fibre
definition: fleece, roving or top sold for spinning or felting.

name: Needlecraft cloth (Aida, evenweave, needlepoint canvas)
definition: counted-thread cloth or canvas made for hand stitching.

name: Straight knitting needle
definition: single-pointed rigid needle sold in pairs for flat knitting.

name: Circular knitting needle
definition: two needle tips joined by a flexible cable.

name: Crochet hook
definition: hooked tool made for crochet.

name: Embroidery hoop
definition: pair of rings that holds cloth taut for hand stitching.

name: Drop spindle
definition: weighted hand spindle made for spinning yarn.

name: Knitting machine
definition: machine that knits fabric with a bed of latch needles.

name: Spinning wheel
definition: wheel-driven device made for spinning fibre into yarn.

name: Loom (hand or mechanical, by `drive`)
definition: frame or machine made for weaving cloth.

name: Needlecraft kit (cross-stitch, embroidery, needlepoint)
definition: kit of printed or counted cloth, floss and needle for one design, sold and compared as one object (K-1).

name: Vegetable-tanned leather
definition: leather tanned with plant tannins, sold as hides, sides or pieces for craft.

name: Chrome-tanned leather
definition: leather tanned with chromium salts, sold for craft.

name: Suede
definition: leather finished on the flesh side to a napped surface, sold for craft.

name: Hair-on hide
definition: tanned hide with the hair left on, sold as craft material.

name: Leather dye
definition: dye made for colouring leather.

name: Leather punch
definition: hand tool made for punching holes in leather.

name: Seed bead
definition: small uniform glass bead sold for bead weaving and stringing.

name: Fire-polished glass bead
definition: faceted glass bead with fire-polished edges.

name: Gemstone bead, drilled
definition: gemstone bead drilled for stringing (K-78).

name: Pearl bead, drilled
definition: pearl drilled for stringing (K-78).

name: Rhinestone and craft stone
definition: faceted glass or synthetic stone made to set or glue on (K-77).

name: Craft shell assortment
definition: unsorted assortment of shells sold for crafts (K-78).

name: Clasp
definition: fastening finding made to close a necklace or bracelet.

name: Beading wire
definition: flexible coated wire made for stringing beads.

name: Jewellery soldering torch and kit
definition: torch or kit made for soldering, brazing or annealing jewellery (C4-O2, K-171).

name: Jeweller's saw
definition: fine-bladed frame saw made for cutting metal in jewellery work.

name: Jewellery pliers
definition: small pliers made for bending wire and closing findings.

name: Cardstock
definition: heavy paper sold in sheets for card making and scrapbooking.

name: Scrapbook album, blank
definition: empty album made for scrapbooking (K-9).

name: Cutting die
definition: shaped metal die used in a die-cutting machine to cut paper.

name: Craft stamp
definition: decorative rubber, clear or wooden stamp made for paper craft (K-171).

name: Ink pad
definition: ink pad made for decorative stamps (K-171).

name: Washi tape
definition: decorative paper masking tape (K-171).

name: Origami paper
definition: square paper sheets made for paper folding (K-171).

name: Earthenware clay
definition: low-fired clay body.

name: Stoneware clay
definition: mid-to-high-fired dense clay body.

name: Porcelain clay
definition: high-fired white translucent clay body.

name: Paper clay
definition: clay body mixed with paper fibre.

name: Air-dry clay
definition: clay that hardens in air without firing.

name: Polymer clay
definition: PVC-based modelling clay hardened in a home oven.

name: Potter's wheel
definition: powered or kick wheel made for throwing pots.

name: Slab roller
definition: machine that rolls clay into even slabs (K-172).

name: Pugmill
definition: machine that mixes and de-airs clay (K-172).

name: Glaze
definition: glassy coating made to be fired onto ceramics.

name: Ceramic kiln (clay)
definition: kiln made for firing clay; `fuel`, `loading` and `chamber_size` are attributes.

name: Acrylic model paint
definition: water-based acrylic paint made for models.

name: Enamel model paint
definition: solvent-based enamel paint made for models.

name: Lacquer model paint
definition: lacquer paint made for models.

name: Model cement
definition: plastic cement made for joining model parts.

name: Modelling putty
definition: filler putty made for model surfaces.

name: Candle wax
definition: wax sold for making candles (K-191).

name: Candle wick
definition: wick sold for making candles.

name: Candle mould
definition: mould made for casting candles.

name: Soap base
definition: melt-and-pour or other soap base sold for making soap.

name: Casting resin
definition: two-part resin sold for craft casting.

name: Craft mould (silicone and other)
definition: mould made for craft casting in resin or plaster.

name: Stained-glass sheet
definition: coloured glass sheet sold for stained-glass work.

name: Mosaic tile
definition: small tile or tessera sold for mosaic work.

name: Glass cutter
definition: hand tool made for scoring glass.

name: Glass-fusing kiln
definition: kiln made only for fusing and slumping glass.

name: Basketry cane and reed
definition: cane or reed sold for weaving baskets.

name: Raffia
definition: palm-fibre strand sold for weaving and craft.

name: Floral foam
definition: absorbent foam made to hold stems in arrangements.

name: Florist wire
definition: wire made for binding and supporting stems.

name: Craft wood blank and shape
definition: wooden plaque, shape or blank sold for crafts.

name: Turning blank
definition: wood blank sold for craft turning.

name: Pyrography pen
definition: heated pen made for burning designs into wood.

name: Craft scissors
definition: scissors made for craft cutting (K-171).

name: Rotary cutter
definition: wheel-bladed hand cutter for fabric and paper.

name: Craft knife (hobby knife)
definition: small replaceable-blade knife for craft cutting.

name: Cutting mat
definition: self-healing mat that protects the work surface during cutting.

name: Craft cutting machine (Cricut-type)
definition: electronic cutting plotter for paper, vinyl and fabric (K-172).

name: Heat press
definition: press that applies heat and pressure to transfer designs onto fabric and other blanks (K-172).

name: Craft glue (PVA and other liquid craft glues)
definition: liquid glue made for crafts (K-171).

name: Hot-glue gun
definition: electric gun that melts glue sticks for craft bonding.

name: Spray adhesive
definition: aerosol adhesive made for crafts.

name: Airbrush
definition: compressed-air spray tool made for fine painting of pictures and models.

name: Craft paint (for decorating objects, by surface)
definition: paint made for decorating craft objects (K-172).

name: Presser foot
definition: interchangeable foot that holds fabric under a sewing-machine needle.

name: Machine needle
definition: needle made for a sewing machine.

name: Extension table
definition: table that clips to a sewing machine to enlarge the bed.

name: Bobbin
definition: spool that holds the lower thread of a sewing machine.

name: Airbrush compressor
definition: compressor made to drive an airbrush (S3).
